I told Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June.

On 14 October Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team. Later that day she posted a correction to 10 June in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. Marcus is in #north-random, so he can see that correction himself. Her original 25 November post in #north-team hasn't been edited, so I warned him not to go by it.

I couldn't find any Brackenwater account file to check the date against, so 10 June comes only from Ilse's correction. I suggested he check with her before he finalises the account sheet.
